question: Do primary AutoCAD APIs define duplicate dictionary-entry behavior well enough to qualify the missing AC1012 DICTIONARY cloning field?

sources.title: Autodesk AutoCAD DXF Reference: DICTIONARY
sources.finding: Dictionary keys are unique. Group 281 values are documented as 0 Not applicable, 1 Keep existing, 2 Use clone, 3 RefMangleName, 4 MangleName, and 5 UnmangleName. Group 350 carries dictionary entry handles as soft-owner references.

sources.title: Autodesk ObjectARX Reference: AcDbDictionary methods
sources.finding: mergeStyle() reads the dictionary merge style; setMergeStyle() sets it for INSERT operations. isTreatElementsAsHard() and setTreatElementsAsHard() concern ownership and are separate properties.

sources.title: Autodesk AutoCAD .NET Reference: DuplicateRecordCloning
sources.finding: Ignore preserves an existing destination record; Replace replaces it; the other modes mangle or unmangle names. The page says ordinary INSERT and Database.insert() operate as Ignore.

sources.title: Autodesk AutoCAD .NET Reference: Database.WblockCloneObjects
sources.finding: The caller supplies a DuplicateRecordCloning argument; dictionary ownership and this explicit operation argument must be recorded independently.

established: The DXF-level duplicate policy field has explicit values in newer profiles.
AutoCAD exposes dictionary mergeStyle and hard/soft ownership as distinct properties.
WblockCloneObjects exposes an operation-level duplicate policy separate from dictionary state.
not_established: The documented sources do not state what AutoCAD returns for mergeStyle() when an AC1012 dictionary has no serialized group 281.
The generic Database.insert() Ignore behavior does not by itself prove R13-to-R14 handling of a populated nested ACAD_MLINESTYLE dictionary.
No native AutoCAD process opened or merged the local specification-directed sample pair in this research pass.
assessment.inference: The sources narrow the required experiment and distinguish its variables, but do not justify assigning an AC1012 default or changing strict-output behavior.

freshSpecificationDirectedPair.discriminator: Both contain canonical NOD -> ACAD_MLINESTYLE -> SAME_KEY ownership; MLINESTYLE start angles are 15 and 37 degrees.
freshSpecificationDirectedPair.generationAndLocalProof: Both files regenerated; AC1012 DICTIONARY physical-frame parsing, shared version-aware observer, role mutation refusal, all truncations, parser reset and corrected retry passed. Candidate strict refusal preserved the destination; explicit partial ASCII/Binary output passed the bounded wire audit.
freshSpecificationDirectedPair.limits: LibreDWG generation and local parser/auditor success do not prove AutoCAD normal-open or native duplicate merge behavior. Files remain scratch-only.

nextStep: On an identified AutoCAD/ObjectARX host, query mergeStyle() and ownership on the normal-open AC1012 sample, then run a documented clone/INSERT operation while recording the operation-level DRC separately; close/reopen and inspect the SAME_KEY target identities and angle. Preserve strict-output refusal pending that witness and the other source/output gates.
